title: fix(app-shell): a flow copy made by New similar shows its runtime status without a reload
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao2xoQoZP3aRMSAvfwSiQRbH)_

Fixes #33052

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：在 Studio 自动化里对流程点「New similar」后，副本打开时页头的状态直接显示「Switched off」（已存储、已关闭），不用再刷新页面。
- 为什么改：副本已经以关闭状态存进运行时，但页面手里的运行状态快照是复制前读的，里面没有副本这一行，于是把它误显示成「Unpublished draft」，管理员会误判它是否会运行。
- 风险与回滚：只在副本落在当前自动化页（当前可写包或只读包配对的 `.custom` 包）时多读一次 `/automation/_status`，每次复制只读一次；真正没有运行时记录的流程仍显示「Unpublished draft」。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 里 `onFlowCopied` 新增的 `setStatusNonce` 一行；`AutomationsPillar.newSimilar-28567.test.tsx` 末尾新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/AutomationsPillar.newSimilar-28567.test.tsx`，预期 11 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- 席位意见：已按 pm-dispatch 审核清单核对：复制落地后只多读一次运行状态，副本马上显示「已关闭」；真正没有运行记录的流程仍显示「未发布的草稿」，状态判定逻辑没改。可落地。

## What changes

**The fix: refresh the snapshot, one read (not a derived row).** `AutomationsPillar.onFlowCopied`, on the branch where the copy opens in this pillar (the open package, or a read-only base's pair), now bumps `statusNonce`, the nonce the `_status` effect already keys on (the ledger toggle and Restore use it the same way). The pillar reads `GET /api/v1/automation/_status` once more, the copy's row arrives, and `deriveFlowRunStatus` reads it: "Switched off".

Why the read and not a derived row: the engine owns the runtime row (`enabled`, `bound`, `triggerType`, `reason`). A row made up on the client from the clone door's answer would be a second, guessed copy of the engine's state. The read takes the server's answer, it is one request per copy, and it uses the path that already exists.

**Unchanged:**
- `deriveFlowRunStatus` is not touched. A flow the engine holds no row for still reads "Unpublished draft" (CONTROL below).
- The other landing, a copy that lands in another package, navigates to that package's pillar. The surface keys the pillar by package, so that mount reads `_status` itself; nothing changes there.
- No server change, no spec change.

**Changeset:** `.changeset/33052-flow-copy-runtime-status.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, with both declaration lines.

## Tests

`views/studio-design/AutomationsPillar.newSimilar-28567.test.tsx`, a new top-level describe in the existing New similar harness (the shared-harness rule):
- PIN: on a writable package whose `_status` serves the original's row, New similar lands a copy here; `_status` now also holds the copy's row (`enabled: false`). The copy's header Status pill reads "Switched off", and not "Unpublished draft".
- READ COUNTER: exactly one more `_status` read after the copy, checked again after a settle and after opening another flow (one read per copy, not per render).
- CONTROL: a flow the engine holds no row for (`intake`) still reads "Unpublished draft" after that same read.

Harness changes, test-only: `_status` can now serve rows (`server.status`; unset keeps the old 404 fallback, so the ten existing cases see what they saw); the real `FlowPreview` is registered at module top, because the header's meta draws only over a registered flow preview; and `@objectstack/lint` is imported at module top, as `check:test-source-alias` asks for a test that reaches the surface's dynamic imports.

**Ablation** (commit `d123f061`, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which needs no build here: the test imports the surface from `src`): removing the `setStatusNonce` line from `onFlowCopied` turns the pin red with `Expected: "Switched off"` / `Received: "Unpublished draft"`; the restore leg read blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

## Acceptance notes

- The pin drives the writable-package landing. The read-only base's pair landing goes through the same `if` branch (`copy.packageId === railPackageId || ... copy.packageId === railPairId`), so the one line covers both; the card's showcase repro is the pair landing.
- Between the copy opening and the `_status` answer, the header can show "Unpublished draft" for the length of one request. That is the existing behaviour of any pillar read (the publish and ledger refreshes work the same way) and not new here.
- Surface grep (`ruling|Ruling-ref|maintainer|⛔`): no hit in the edited region of `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, none in `AutomationsFlowRail.tsx` or the test file; four `⛔` hits in `flow-problems.ts` (the reason text is never parsed; an absent registration is never read as `registered`), a file this PR does not edit, and the derivation they guard is unchanged.
